summary: Straight-line __thiscall accessor that copies the two consecutive DWORD fields at this+0x60 and this+0x64 into the output pointers a2 and a3, and returns the value of the second field (this+0x64). No guard, no side effect beyond the two pointer writes.

operations.description: Return the value read from this+0x64, the same value written to *a3.
Called by ConditionalMultiParamDispatch (0x004861A0), which uses this accessor to expose the two fields through its multi-parameter dispatch.

unresolved: Meaning of the two fields at this+0x60 / this+0x64 and the purpose of returning the second one are unknown.
